I will manage this small maize piece the way I can afford, not in a big way. Last season I used a little fertilizer on the maize and saw it helped, so this year I will still put some, but not much because cash is tight and this plot is only 0.17 ha. I will use improved seed if I can get the small pack, and I will also put manure from home because this is my own land. I do not usually spray maize here, and I will wait for the rains, not irrigate.
